about: Ky's hand grades for 20 answers, the yardstick for every grader and prompt change (ROADMAP v1.1). Each entry shows the scenario exactly as the learner saw it (role, situation, task), then their answer. For each answer, fill in taskMet (yes / partly / no) and list every mistake as { skill, quote }. Skill ids are in src/core/skills.ts. Answers are written the way phone dictation delivers them: little punctuation, no capital letters.
